description:
Shortcut-driven translation for anything you see, write or say, in any app.

Trancy Air is a desktop translation tool driven by shortcuts. Select a sentence or word to get an instant translation with phonetics, definitions and examples, type in your own language and replace it in place with the target language, or hold a shortcut and speak to turn speech into translated text. It also offers screenshot translation, comparison of several AI translation engines, sentence splitting and grammar analysis, a save-for-later word card flow with pronunciation scoring, and sync to the Trancy Learning Center.
- Word cards now offer AI meanings based on the sentence.
- Turn on automatic word pronunciation in Settings > Translate.
- Find all shortcuts in Settings > Shortcuts.
- Retry a failed translation in Compare Translate.
- Fixed shortcuts sometimes stopping and reduced background resource use.
- Scroll long content in Smart Translate and word cards.
- Image Translate no longer freezes on blank areas.
- Get help adding a missing read-aloud voice.
- Typing a full-width comma no longer opens Settings.
- Improved voice input for some microphones.
- Select, copy and look up words in Input Translate results.
- See what is new after an update.
